records.d: Roman roads engineered the first smart network: straight, drained, and standardized across an empire. The road was infrastructure. The oldest smart road is a Roman one.
records.h: Layered construction with drainage and milestones created an all-weather network. The road was the empire's nervous system. The infrastructure was the intelligence.
records.mj: Established - documented Roman road engineering; standardized imperial network.
records.t: c. 300 BCE: Roman Roads - the First Network

records.d: Cleveland installed the first electric traffic signal in 1914: the road gained a brain. Intersections were managed. The street learned to think.
records.h: Electric red-green signals with a warning tone controlled crossings. The intersection was automated. The road made decisions.
records.mj: Established - documented 1914 Cleveland installation; first electric traffic signal.

records.d: Painted lane markings in the 1920s organized the road: the surface communicated. Drivers read the street. The road became an interface.
records.h: Center lines and lane paint guided drivers visually. The communication was passive. The interface was paint.
records.mj: Established - documented 1920s lane markings; visual road organization.

records.d: The 1956 Interstate Act built 41,000 miles of highway: the road network at continental scale. The nation was connected. The system was the smart.
records.h: Standardized limited-access highways with uniform design connected the country. The scale was unprecedented. The network was the intelligence.
records.mj: Established - documented 1956 Act; Interstate Highway System.

records.d: Inductive loop detectors in the 1960s sensed cars in the pavement: the road felt traffic. Signals adapted. The street gained senses.
records.h: Wire loops in the pavement detected vehicles magnetically, feeding signal controllers. The sensing was embedded. The road felt.
records.mj: Established - documented inductive loop detectors; embedded traffic sensing.

records.d: Ramp meters in the 1970s paced freeway entries: the road managed flow. Merges were metered. The highway thought ahead.
records.h: Signals on on-ramps released cars at controlled rates. The flow smoothed. The management was active.
records.mj: Established - documented ramp metering; active freeway flow management.

records.d: Variable message signs in the 1980s talked to drivers: the road gave advice. Warnings appeared. The highway communicated.
records.h: Electronic signs displayed warnings and guidance. The messages were dynamic. The road spoke.
records.mj: Established - documented variable message signs; dynamic driver communication.

records.d: Electronic tolling in the 1990s charged cars at speed: the road knew its users. Stops vanished. The transaction was wireless.
records.h: Transponders and gantries billed vehicles without stopping. The identification was automatic. The road recognized.
records.mj: Established - documented electronic tolling; automatic vehicle identification.

records.d: Traffic cameras in the 2000s watched intersections: the road saw violations. Enforcement automated. The street had eyes.
records.h: Cameras detected red-light and speed violations. The watching was constant. The enforcement was automatic.
records.mj: Established - documented traffic cameras; automated enforcement.

records.d: Smart parking around 2010 sensed open spots: the street knew availability. Drivers were guided. The curb became intelligent.
records.h: In-ground sensors reported space occupancy to apps. The guidance was real-time. The curb computed.
records.mj: Established - documented smart parking; sensor-guided parking.

records.d: Solar Roadways crowdfunded in 2014: solar panels as roads. The idea went viral. The road would power.
records.h: The campaign proposed LED-lit solar road surfaces. The funding was viral. The engineering was questioned.
records.mj: Established - documented 2014 campaign; Solar Roadways crowdfunding.

records.d: France's Wattway solar road opened in December 2016: a kilometer of photovoltaic pavement. The road generated. The experiment was real.
records.h: Solar panels paved a Normandy road. The output disappointed. The lesson was cost.
records.mj: Established - documented December 2016 Wattway; solar road test.

records.d: Jinan's solar highway opened in December 2017: photovoltaic expressway in China. The highway generated. The scale was Chinese.
records.h: Solar panels under transparent concrete paved two kilometers. The test was ambitious. The road powered.
records.mj: Established - documented December 2017 opening; Jinan solar highway.

records.d: Sweden's eRoadArlanda electrified 2 km of road in 2018: EVs charging while driving. The road fueled. The highway was a charger.
records.h: An electrified rail in the road charged vehicles dynamically. The test worked. The road powered cars.
records.mj: Established - documented 2018 eRoadArlanda; electrified road test.

records.d: 5G vehicle-to-everything trials in 2019 connected cars to roads: the conversation began. The car talked to the street. The network was forming.
records.h: C-V2X radios let vehicles and infrastructure exchange data. The trials were multi-city. The standard was emerging.
records.mj: Emerging - real trials; 5G V2X vehicle-infrastructure communication.

records.d: Connected intersections deployed in 2020: signals broadcasting to cars. The light talked. The intersection communicated.
records.h: SPaT messages told vehicles signal timing. The coordination was digital. The light was smart.
records.mj: Emerging - real deployments; connected intersections.

records.d: Michigan's connected automated vehicle corridor advanced in 2021: a smart road for autonomous shuttles. The corridor was dedicated. The road served robots.
records.h: Cavnue planned sensor-equipped corridors for automated transit. The infrastructure was purpose-built. The robots had a road.
records.mj: Emerging - real program; Michigan CAV corridor.

records.d: Indiana piloted wireless EV-charging highway in 2022: the road as charger, American edition. The pavement powered. The pilot was Hoosier.
records.h: INDOT and Purdue tested in-road wireless charging. The research was public. The road charged.
records.mj: Emerging - real pilot; Indiana wireless charging highway.

records.d: C-V2X deployments grew in 2023: connected corridors in multiple regions. The network spread. The standard matured.
records.h: Roadside units proliferated on smart corridors. The coverage grew. The ecosystem formed.
records.mj: Emerging - real deployments; C-V2X corridor growth.

records.d: Smart road pilots multiplied in 2024: sensor roads, dynamic charging, adaptive signals. The experiments scaled. The road learned.
records.h: Pilots tested integrated smart road systems. The data accumulated. The learning was real.
records.mj: Emerging - real pilots; integrated smart road systems.

records.d: By 2025, V2X standards were solidifying: the rules for car-road talk. The language was standardized. The conversation had grammar.
records.h: Standards bodies finalized message sets and security. The interoperability was specified. The grammar was written.
records.mj: Emerging - real standards work; V2X standardization.

records.d: Dynamic charging pilots expanded in 2025: more roads charging moving EVs. The charger disappeared into pavement. The range anxiety faded.
records.h: New pilots in Europe and the US extended dynamic charging. The technology matured. The pavement powered.
records.mj: Emerging - real pilots; dynamic wireless charging expansion.
